about.title: Hi, I'm {name}.
text: I live in Duisburg and study Mobility and Logistics (B.Sc.) at Rhine-Waal University of Applied Sciences (HSRW). Alongside that, I combine three things that usually take three different agencies: design, development and Google Ads.
I take on only one new project per month. That way you get my full attention – personally, in German or English.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Your question isn't here? Just write to me.

price.q: How much does a website cost?
price.a: Your website comes as a monthly subscription: Start €45, Business €75, Growth €449 per month (net) – hosting, maintenance and changes included, no setup fee. For new customers the first month is free. Web apps, shops and automation are quoted individually.

timeline.q: How long does a project take?
timeline.a: It depends on the scope and on how quickly texts and images are ready. We set the schedule together in the first call.

hosting.q: Where will my website be hosted?
hosting.a: Hosting and the SSL certificate are included in the subscription. Your website runs with a reliable provider using EU servers or GDPR-compliant contracts.

changes.q: Can I change things after launch?
changes.a: Yes. Depending on the package, 1 to 3 changes per month are included – for example new opening hours, texts or images. We discuss bigger extensions first.

language.q: Do you work in English too?
language.a: Yes. I work in German and English, and your website can be bilingual too.

term.a: The minimum term is 12 months; after that the subscription can be cancelled monthly. For new customers the first month is free.

cafe.title: Café Hafenbohne
cafe.summary: Website for a café: menu, opening hours and table booking.
cafe.problem: Guests only find opening hours and the menu on social media; bookings come in by phone only.
cafe.solution: A warm one-page website with menu, opening hours, directions and a booking form – optimised for phones.
cafe.goal: More bookings online, fewer calls at peak times and better visibility on Google Maps.

handwerk.title: Müller Elektro
handwerk.summary: Trust-focused website for an electrician with an emergency service.
handwerk.problem: The old website looks outdated, and the emergency number is hard to find on a phone.
handwerk.solution: A clear structure, an always-visible emergency button, services at a glance and a simple quote request.
handwerk.goal: More qualified enquiries from Duisburg and the area, and faster contact in an emergency.

export.title: Gaibandha Jute Co.
export.summary: B2B website for a jute exporter, English first.
export.problem: International buyers can't find product data, minimum order quantities or shipping terms.
export.solution: A product catalogue with specifications, MOQs and Incoterms, plus a structured enquiry form.
export.goal: Better enquiries from wholesalers worldwide – with everything needed for a fast quote.

luxury.title: Maison Noir Duft
luxury.summary: Cinematic brand website with a 3D bottle and a scroll story.
luxury.problem: A new fragrance brand needs a presence that feels premium and stays in people's minds.
luxury.solution: A dark, elegant site with a real 3D bottle that turns as you scroll, and a story in three chapters.
luxury.goal: A brand people talk about – and more requests for sample sets and wholesale.

sections.title: 2. Hosting (Netlify)
text: This website is hosted by Netlify, Inc., 101 2nd Street, San Francisco, CA 94105, USA. When you visit the website, Netlify processes technically necessary data (e.g. IP address, date and time, page visited, browser) in server log files to deliver the website and protect it against attacks.

The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in secure, stable operation). Transfers to the USA are based on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or standard contractual clauses. A data processing agreement with Netlify is in place. <CHECK: DPA WITH NETLIFY SIGNED>

sections.title: 3. Fonts
text: Fonts are served locally from this server (self-hosted via next/font). No connection is made to Google Fonts servers.

sections.title: 4. Project request form and email delivery (Resend)
text: When you use the request form, I process your details (name, email, type of business, services needed, budget, start date, message) to answer your request. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (pre-contractual measures) or Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.
To deliver the request to me I use Resend (Resend, Inc., USA). Transfers to the USA are based on standard contractual clauses or the EU-US Data Privacy Framework. <CHECK: DPA WITH RESEND>
Your data is deleted once it is no longer needed for this purpose and no legal retention obligations apply.

sections.title: 5. Abuse protection (Upstash)
text: To protect the form and the chat against spam and abuse, the number of requests from one IP address is counted for a short time. I use Upstash for this (Upstash, Inc.; database region: <REGION, e.g. Frankfurt>). Entries expire automatically after a few minutes. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.

sections.title: 6. AI chat assistant (Google Gemini)
text: You can use an AI assistant on this website. Your messages are sent to Google's Gemini API (Google Ireland Ltd. / Google LLC) to generate the answers. Please do not enter sensitive data in the chat.
If you explicitly agree in the chat, your name, email, type of business and project description are forwarded to me by email (via Resend, see section 4).

The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) or (f) GDPR, and your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR) for forwarding your details. <CHECK: On the free Gemini tier, Google may use inputs to improve its services. For live operation, check the paid tier or the current terms and update this section.>

sections.title: 7. Cookies and tracking
text: This website sets no tracking or marketing cookies and uses no analytics tools. Therefore no cookie banner is needed.

sections.title: 8. Your rights
text: You have the right of access (Art. 15), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction of processing (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20) and to object (Art. 21 GDPR). You can withdraw consent at any time with effect for the future.
You can lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, e.g. the State Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information of North Rhine-Westphalia (LDI NRW).
